text:
Discharge summary
Admission 2036-08-23, discharge 2036-09-09.
Autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T cell infusion on 2036-08-24 for relapsed follicular lymphoma with transformation.
Hospital course:
- CRS: fever from Day +2, tocilizumab x2. Progressive hypoxemic respiratory failure on Day +5; intubated 2036-08-29, propofol sedation, extubated 2036-09-02 at 10:00 (propofol stopped 09:30). CRS resolved by Day +9.
- Neurotoxicity: ICE 7/10 on 2036-08-28, ICE 5/10 on 2036-08-29. Treated with dexamethasone. ICE 9/10 on 2036-09-04 at 08:00 and 10/10 on 2036-09-06 at 09:00. EEG 2036-09-04 normal.
- Infectious: blood cultures negative.
Discharge exam: ambulating independantly, no focal deficits.
Follow-up in clinic in one week.
